messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
But no, work was more important to my boss.

output.original_text: But no, work was more important to my boss.
output.joy: But no, work was so important to my boss, and I felt proud to be a part of it!
output.sadness: But no, work was more important to my boss, and it hurt to see my efforts overlooked.
output.fear: But no, work was more important to my boss, and I was afraid of disappointing them further.
output.anger: But no, work was more important to my boss, and it infuriated me how they prioritized it over everything else.
output.surprise: But no, work was more important to my boss; I was shocked they didn’t see the bigger picture!
output.disgust: But no, work was more important to my boss, which just felt so wrong and callous.
